messages.subject: For Olivier Andries | Government relations, international affairs and aerospace growth
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Malek,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Olivier Andries, Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

Safran's international aerospace platform operates across government customers, industrial partnerships, regulation, investment and long-term stakeholder relationships. Those priorities closely match my current executive responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex multinational operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of government relations, international stakeholder leadership and cross-functional execution could support Safran's global priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Safran.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
